transcript.content: Hello, nice to meet you. What brings you into the clinic today?
Mostly, I’m here because I’m tired in a way that doesn’t really make sense. I can sleep and keep up with work, but I still feel like I’m running on a low battery before the day even gets going.
Along with this fatigue, have you been feeling down, depressed, or hopeless?

Yeah. It’s been a long time—most days I just feel kind of gray and flat. Things I used to look forward to, like fishing or working in my tomatoes, even a church concert, they feel more like things to check off than things I actually enjoy.
Roughly how long have you been feeling this gray and flat most days?
About two years and four months, I’d say. It started when I got pulled back into full operational leadership.
Before this started two years ago, had you ever experienced another time in your life when you felt depressed or lost interest in things like this?
I’m not really sure. Nothing stands out to me as another stretch like this before.
During these past two years and four months, have you had any break lasting more than two months where your mood felt completely back to normal?
No, I can’t say there’s been a stretch that long where I felt completely back to normal. It’s been there since I went back into full operational leadership, about two years and four months ago.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight during this time?
Yeah, my appetite’s been off more days than not. I’ll work right through lunch without really noticing, then just pick at dinner. My wife says my pants look looser, and I’m not trying to lose weight.
Have you been struggling with feelings of worthlessness or blaming yourself excessively for things?
I wouldn’t say I’ve been blaming myself a lot, no. I just feel worn down by it, more than anything.
Have you been having trouble concentrating, focusing on tasks, or making everyday decisions?
I’m not sure I’ve noticed much of a change there. I can still focus and make the usual day-to-day decisions.
Have you had any thoughts of death, or felt like you would be better off not waking up?
No, I haven’t had thoughts like that.
